x: In the A.A.A. 10 mile track championship at Hurlingham on Easter Saturday, 21st April, Gerry North (running in Blackpool's colours) was 3rd in 48:38.2 after a tremendous tussle with his cross-country rival Melvin Batty who just edged into second place with 48:38.0. This year's winner was Chelmsford's American star L.
In the Finchley '20' on April 27th the weather and Buddy Edelen triumphed! There was an incredible number of retirements and we were affected certainly as much as the other clubs.
